mostWorthwhile.text: Following icy pebbles into the warm ring was most worthwhile: their ice became vapor while the rocky remains joined the inner gathering, linking the two regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Breaking the loose icy clumps felt repetitive after the previous chapter's similar fragmentation sequence.

surprise.text: The broken fragments gathered fresh dust without simply restoring the original clumps, a useful distinction.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the cold ring's role became clearer when gas drag and pressure concentrated the solids.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what happens to the concentrated swarms, though the repeated growth-and-fragmentation pattern makes me somewhat hesitant.
